scope: synthetic diagnostic pilot, not biological motif confirmation
synthetic_pattern_note: abstract contiguous 12bp planted pattern, not a biological -35/-10 spacing model
representation: FULL/LOCAL MEAN and ORDER use the same fully contained core tokens; ORDER concatenates them. A0 is a separate legacy base/window mean control. Mini-c averages 12 core base states.
local_boundary: fixed 24bp crops shifted inward at sequence edges; exact crop/core offsets saved

evaluation.test_policy: protocol frozen before execution; test scored after all fits, no selection or tuning from test
evaluation.reference_usage: evaluation-only family matching; oracle family mapping makes metrics reference-assisted
evaluation.fpr: report blank-control FPR for every candidate, including candidates failing reference gate

next_gate: compare paired condition-level deltas to OH and legacy A0; two data seeds are descriptive only, no model winner or causal tokenization claim
